properties.name: Allentown permit zone
properties.notes: Residential permit zone covering streets around Allen St, Franklin St, and lower Elmwood. Protects residents from spillover parking from bars and the arts district.

properties.name: Elmwood Village permit zone
properties.notes: Residential permit zone covering side streets off Elmwood Ave between Bryant St and W Ferry St. Protects residents from restaurant and bar parking overflow.

properties.name: UB South / University Heights permit zone
properties.notes: Residential permit zone around UB South Campus (Main St and Bailey Ave area). Protects residents from student and employee parking overflow during university hours.
